title: Soft and Normal · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Soft and Normal · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a three-beat pattern of soft and normal claps. The lead performs the pattern and a partner copies it. The partner repeats the soft and normal claps in order. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Soft and Normal, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner repeats the soft and normal claps in order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The partner repeats the soft and normal claps in order.
